fn binomial(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (0 <= k)
  requires (k <= n)
  ensures (result == (if ((k == 0) or (k == n)) then 1 else if (k == 1) then n else (binomial((n - 1), (k - 1)) + binomial((n - 1), k))))
  effects pure
  example (binomial(0, 0) == 1)
  example (binomial(2, 1) == 2)
